translations.web: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”
translations.bsb: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed. He will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.”
translations.kjv: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
